data_sources.citation_apa: U.S. Geological Survey. (2025). Annual National Land Cover Database (NLCD), Collection 1, Version 1.1. U.S. Geological Survey data release. https://doi.org/10.5066/P94UXNTS
data_sources.description: Annual NLCD is distinct from Legacy NLCD. This catalog pins C1V1 (map years 1985–2024) to match the local downloader and verified release metadata. C1V2 is a separate newer release; the shared DOI alone is not a version pin. [Resource reconciliation: inventory rights and history] Inventory usage/citation statement (Amadeus data sources!I6): Public domain (U.S. Gov); citation requested. Inventory source status (H6): Active (Annual NLCD); this is not observation QA, API availability or verified support for every product. Inventory first-release/history wording (J6): 2024. The source row describes the Annual series launch in 2024, while the broader inventory and bibliography also contain Legacy NLCD. Neither the Legacy dates nor Legacy DOIs identify Annual C1V1.

products.name: nlcd_annual_c1v1_lndcov
products.label: Annual NLCD C1V1 CONUS — Land Cover
products.spatial_extent_descriptor: Conterminous United States; map years 1985–2024, C1V1.
products.native_spatial_resolution_descriptor: Native 30 m equal-area pixels on WGS84 Albers; not EPSG:5070.
products.description: Pinned Annual NLCD C1V1; select download_nlcd(product="Land Cover", year=YYYY). Archive Annual_NLCD_LndCov_YYYY_CU_C1V1.zip. Each annual map is a modelled land-surface product, not a year-long measurement at every pixel. Nominal land-cover classes; use class proportions or nearest-category lookup, never a mean of integer IDs. Local crs AMADEUS:100001 is defined by the linked grid proj_string; it is not an EPSG code or database SRID. A newer C1V2 release must not be silently substituted. [Resource reconciliation: inventory completeness] Inventory coverage statement (Amadeus data sources!N6): Yes (CONUS). This statement does not establish validity of every cell/date or fill observation gaps.

product_variables.label: Land Cover
product_variables.harmonization_note: Nominal land-cover classes; use class proportions or nearest-category lookup, never a mean of integer IDs. Annual NLCD nodata differs from legacy NLCD (do not apply the old 0/255 policy). No provider range is assigned to canonical plausible_min/max. A catalogue record is not verification that calculate_nlcd implements all six product semantics. Provider encoding UINT8. Category codes: 11 water, 12 ice/snow, 21–24 developed classes, 31 barren, 41–43 forest classes, 52 shrub/scrub, 71 grass/herbaceous, 81 pasture/hay, 82 crops, 90 woody wetland, 95 emergent wetland; other integers are not automatically valid classes.

product_variables.label: Land Cover Change
product_variables.harmonization_note: Unchanged pixels retain a class code; changed pixels concatenate previous/current codes. These are nominal transitions, not numeric magnitudes. Annual NLCD nodata differs from legacy NLCD (do not apply the old 0/255 policy). No provider range is assigned to canonical plausible_min/max. A catalogue record is not verification that calculate_nlcd implements all six product semantics. Provider encoding UINT16. Validity requires the class/transition vocabulary, not just the reported numeric envelope 11–9590.

product_variables.label: Land Cover Confidence
product_variables.harmonization_note: Confidence score on a 1–100 scale; not calibrated correctness probability. Annual NLCD nodata differs from legacy NLCD (do not apply the old 0/255 policy). No provider range is assigned to canonical plausible_min/max. A catalogue record is not verification that calculate_nlcd implements all six product semantics. Provider encoding UINT8; documented score domain 1–100. This encoding range is not a physical plausibility bound.

product_variables.label: Fractional Impervious Surface
product_variables.harmonization_note: Percentage of pixel area covered by impervious surface; zero is valid, 250 is missing. Annual NLCD nodata differs from legacy NLCD (do not apply the old 0/255 policy). No provider range is assigned to canonical plausible_min/max. A catalogue record is not verification that calculate_nlcd implements all six product semantics. Provider encoding UINT8; valid physical percentage 0–100. Do not include missing code 250 in arithmetic.

product_variables.label: Impervious Descriptor
product_variables.harmonization_note: 0 non-urban, 1 roads, 2 urban; zero is a valid class. Annual NLCD nodata differs from legacy NLCD (do not apply the old 0/255 policy). No provider range is assigned to canonical plausible_min/max. A catalogue record is not verification that calculate_nlcd implements all six product semantics. Provider encoding UINT8; allowed class codes are exactly 0, 1 and 2.

product_variables.label: Spectral Change Day of Year
product_variables.harmonization_note: Values 1–366 are day-of-year labels; 0 means no detected change. Not a Julian calendar date or a duration; do not average these labels. Annual NLCD nodata differs from legacy NLCD (do not apply the old 0/255 policy). No provider range is assigned to canonical plausible_min/max. A catalogue record is not verification that calculate_nlcd implements all six product semantics. Provider encoding UINT16; code 0 means no detected change; 1–366 identify Gregorian ordinal day, subject to map year.
